name: open-code-review
description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: An AI reviewer that reads a programmer's proposed code changes and leaves precise, line-by-line comments pointing out bugs and security holes — like having a very thorough senior engineer check every change before it ships.
buyer: An engineering manager at a 20-50 person software company who wants fewer bugs reaching production without hiring more senior reviewers.
business_use_cases: A dev agency wires it into every client project's pull-request pipeline and advertises 'AI-audited code' as a quality guarantee.
A coding bootcamp uses it to auto-grade and give detailed feedback on every student assignment instead of paying human graders.
A SaaS wraps it with billing and dashboards and sells it to small dev teams as a hosted 'PR reviewer' service.

money_ideas.idea: Host it as a per-seat SaaS that plugs into a team's GitHub and reviews every pull request automatically.
Charge usage-based fees per pull request reviewed for teams that only want occasional deep audits.

steal_this: Stand up a hosted 'PR review bot' this weekend, connect it to a few small dev teams' GitHub repos via webhook, and charge a flat monthly fee per repo.
